observations: Photo 0: Rear-top view of a black mirrorless camera body held in a hand, mode dial, on/off switch, lock switch, and hot shoe visible, 'Canon EOS' text partly visible.
Photo 1: Front view with no lens attached, lens mount open showing sensor, 'Canon EOS R10' text clearly printed on body.
Photo 2: Rear view showing control dials, joystick, AF-ON, menu buttons, viewfinder eyecup, no screen content visible (screen appears off or folded away from view).
No lens is attached in any photo, consistent with seller's 'body alone' claim.
No battery, charger, box, or accessories are visible in any of the three photos.
No photo shows the camera powered on, no LCD/menu screen, no shutter count, no serial number plate, no sensor close-up free of dust/scratches.

claims.evidence: photo 1 shows 'Canon EOS R10' printed on the body
no lens attached in photo 0, 1, or 2; mount is empty in photo 1
no battery or charger appears in any of the three photos

risks.risk: Battery and charger may not actually be included or may be third-party/degraded
risks.proof: A photo showing the battery, its model sticker, and the charger together with the camera
risks.if_unproven: priced as body only, no accessories

risks.risk: Camera may not power on or may have functional faults (autofocus, buttons, dials)
risks.proof: A photo or short clip of the camera powered on showing the rear LCD/menu screen and a live view image

risks.risk: Shutter count/usage level unknown, affects remaining lifespan
risks.proof: A photo of the shutter count from a menu screen or software readout

risks.risk: Sensor condition (dust, scratches, fungus) cannot be confirmed from a wide hand-held shot
risks.proof: A close-up, well-lit photo of the sensor alone, ideally with a light source behind it
risks.if_unproven: priced as sensor condition unknown, assume needs cleaning

risks.risk: Cosmetic condition (dents, cracks, mount wear) partly hidden by hand and angle
risks.proof: Clear photos of all sides including the grip, base plate, and card door without fingers blocking the body

risks.risk: Possible grey-market or region-locked firmware, or non-genuine refurbishment
risks.proof: Photo of serial number plate matched against Canon's checker, and any accompanying invoice
risks.if_unproven: priced as unverified origin, standard used price only

proof_requests: Photo of the camera powered on showing the rear screen/menu
Photo of shutter count from the menu
Photo of the battery, its label, and the charger laid out together
Close-up, well-lit photo of the sensor
Photo of the serial number plate (usually base plate)
response.reason: The item is clearly identified as a Canon EOS R10 body from photo 1, so it can be priced at worst case: body-only, accessories and functionality unverified, with risks listed for later adjustment.
